hooks.name: Ledger property tests
hooks.description: After Kiro edits a file under backend/app/ledger/, run the ledger property, scenario, and boundary tests.

action.prompt:
Ledger property tests hook. Apply ONLY if the file you just edited is under backend/app/ledger/. Otherwise ignore this hook.

Run: cd backend && uv run pytest -q tests/test_ledger_properties.py tests/test_ledger_scenario.py tests/test_ledger_boundary.py

If a hypothesis test fails:
1. Show the falsifying example (counterexample) hypothesis printed.
2. Fix the bug in backend/app/ledger/ (not the test, unless the test is wrong; say which).
3. Add a named regression test (e.g. test_regression_<short_description>) that reproduces the counterexample as a fixed example.
4. Re-run the tests until they pass.
5. Add an entry to docs/KIRO_LOG.md under the "Property-based testing" heading (create the heading if missing): the counterexample, root cause, fix, and regression test name.
Report the result in a few lines.
